snippet.title: Aberrate Inc. - SXSW Award‑Winning 3D Puzzle Game | Official Announce Trailer | Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
Coming Q4 2026 - Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3620390/Aberrate_Inc/

In Aberrate Inc. you guide N.T.R.N., a curious little maintenance robot, through cozy logic puzzles by splitting, moving, and combining red and blue boxes to power doors, platforms, and odd office machines. Winner of SXSW Sydney’s Best Student Game Award 2025.

Aberrate Inc. focuses on clean, readable logic puzzles that make you feel clever when they click. Short, low‑pressure levels that invite you to experiment! 

A third‑person 3D puzzle game from Chilltop Games, published by Ripstone, targeting a Q4 2026 release on PC via Steam.

Platforms & Release Window  
- Platform: PC (Steam)  
- Release: Q4 2026  

Developed by: Chilltop Games (Australia)  
Published by: Ripstone (UK)
